answer: Mechanism Name: Behavior Analysis on Vertex Interaction Enforcement Rule: Upon detecting a high volume of interactions from identical or very similar profiles on the same vertex, the system flags these identities for review. Concrete Cost: An attacker must create diverse profiles that exhibit plausible, varied behaviors, significantly increasing operational complexity and costs. If an attacker attempts to harbor multiple identities with similar patterns, they incur the overhead of crafting unique interaction histories and profiles, akin to a willow bending but not breaking under the load,
